newsitem.title: USA: Furr's/Bishop's names Reimer interim CEO.
newsitem.headline: Furr's/Bishop's names Reimer interim CEO.

text.p: Furr's/Bishop's Inc said on Thursday that Kenneth Reimer will assume the title of president and chief executive officer on an interim basis.
Reimer, an independent director and former president and chief executive of Tony Roma's restaurants, is replacing Kevin Lewis, Furr's/Bishop's said.
Lewis announced his plans in June to drop those titles and remain as chairman, the company said.
Furr's/Bishops said it has been searching for a permanent successor since June 1996.
Furr's/Bishop's said that its year-to-date profits are significantly ahead of a year ago.

In the first nine months of 1996, the company reported a profit of $7.5 million, or $0.15 a share on revenues of $149.5 million. In the comparable year ago period, the company reported a $19.3 million loss, or $0.40 a share, on revenues of $160.9 million.
In 1995, the company reported an operating loss of $38.8 million, before an extraordinary gain of $170.2 million for a financial restructuring, on revenues of $210.2 million.
Furr's/Bishop's said its year-to-date comparable store sales are even with last year's, despite cuts in advertising spending.
